tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Provided Project Management Consultancy services in a single Urban Infrastructure Project with a consultancy fee of not less than Rs 100 Lakhs during the last 5 years as mentioned in bid document.

Should have satisfactorily completed minimum one similar nature of work comprising of Design and Project Management Consultancy services for any Government/ Government Under taken projects as per bid document.

The Consultant should have Own Material testing Laboratory facilities with NABL /NACC Accreditation or having MOU with NABL/NACC Accreditation laboratories. The firm must have minimum equipment as either owned or leased as per bid documents
Consultant must have instrument and softwares as mentioned in bid document.
